programme.title: Mystery Woman 8: Wild West Mystery
programme.desc: Former Red River TV series star Clint Lawson's Wild West show is in town, the prize act in the annual festival, which the sponsoring bookshop is presiding over. He strains a leg due to a sabotaged saddle strap. His stand-in, Dogie, is fatally shot while starring in his place, so who was the intended target? Evidence seems to pile up against Clint, so the chief simply jails him without further investigation. However, the bookshop sleuths team digs up dirty secrets from their past and that of other show cast, such as ex-con announcer Jeb Fletcher, Clint's ex-lover Annie whom he promised a movie part like Strother Elam, and Zeke Foster, who secretly deals in illegitimate Red River memorabilia.

programme.title: Redeemer
programme.desc: A writer is touched by the story of a former Black Panther who seams to have been wrongfully convicted to life imprisonment 20 years ago. The writer decides to try to help the now middle-aged convict get exonerated.

programme.title: Acceptance
programme.desc: Paul confesses his feelings to Rosanna. He gets Rosanna to admit to her feelings for him but she insists she cant think about anything but Cabots welfare for now. She agrees to leave the door open between them. Meanwhile, Barbara goes to James to let him know that his plan for Jordan and Rosanna is falling apart. She indirectly asks James for his help in making sure Jordan and Rosanna stay together. Soon after, Cabot mysteriously appears in the middle of Fairwinds, when neither Paul nor Rosanna put him there! A new clue appears in the paper and Chris, Alison, Emily and Susan are all trying to figure it out. When Nancy cant help, Alison goes to Aaron. He agrees to help her, and Alison doesnt tell him about her engagement. Meanwhile, Bob helps Chris with the clue. Chris hurries to the dance studio where the key is apparently hidden and finds a tango lesson underway. Emily and Chris agree to take a tango lesson in order to get to the key. They are dancing together when Alison and Aaron arrive outside. Alison is about to go in when Aaron notices her ring. Tom confronts Margo about the compact and she tells him its not hers. Tom asks her one more time if it was only a kiss between her and Doc. Margo confirms the lie and they agree to try to move on. Jill has overheard everything. She confronts Margo after Tom leaves, promising to keep quiet about what she has witnessed on one condition. Meanwhile, Ben tells Jessica hell agree to in Vitro. At the hospital, Jessica bumps into Doc and admits shes been too hard on him. Then Dr. Schilling informs her she isnt a candidate for in vitro because shes already pregnant! Doc looks on as Ben hugs Jessica to celebrate the good news.

programme.title: DC 9/11: Time of Crisis
programme.desc: Gideon Banks lost his wife Liz and son Simon in a horrific car accident some twenty years ago. At the time of the accident he was involved in something called the Neural Archiving Project - NAP for short. The technology was developed to create smart computers - transferring human engrams to computers. The company eventually gave up on the technology, but Gideon didn't. After years of quietly perfecting it, he built a small robot, from parts he stole from Concorde Robotics, where he now works. Zoe, Gideon's niece, discovers Gideon's secret, the robot contains actual neural engrams from the real Simon. She becomes worried not only about Gideon but also about the robot that sounds and acts a lot like her little cousin used to.

programme.title: The Colt
programme.desc: In 1864, an American Civil War troop struggles to survive when young Union (American Civil War) soldier Jim Rabb (Ryan Merriman) discovers that his mare has given birth to a Colt (horse). A superior officer orders Jim to shoot the foal because it may become a burden, but Jim - seeing the colt as a sign of hope and a reminder of the beauty of life - refuses. The colt remains with the men as they battle. When Confederacy (American Civil War)s overtake the camp and steal the colt, Jim must risk his life retrieving it.

programme.title: The Long Shot
programme.desc: Drama. A woman moves with her seven-year-old daughter and husband to California from Colorado. After her husband abandons them, she tries to rebuild their lives. Finding solace caring for horses, she decides to enter a horse show.

programme.title: Monte Walsh
programme.desc: Montelius "Monte" Walsh (Tom Selleck) is an aging cowboy facing the final days of the Wild West era. He and his friend Chet Rollins (Keith Carradine), another long-time cowhand, work at whatever ranch work comes their way, but "nothing they can't do from a horse". Their lives are divided between months on the range and the occasional trip into town. Camaraderie and competition with the other cowboys fill their days. They seek work and take a job at the ranch of Cal Brennan (William Devane), where they meet an old friend, Shorty Austin (George Eads), another ranch hand.

programme.title: Charms for the Easy Life
programme.desc: Drama with Gena Rowlands. The story of three women who live in a North Carolina town and defy the traditional roles set forth for them by society.

programme.title: A Bear Named Winnie
programme.desc: Based on the true story behind author A.A. Milne's beloved character, Winnie the Pooh, this is a tale of the remarkable friendship between a Canadian soldier and the cub that stood as a symbol of friendship and hope in a world plagued by war.

programme.title: The Curse Of the King Tut
programme.desc: Thousands of years ago, the great Child King Tutankhamen ruled. Few know the details of his life no one knows the secrets of his death. But all is about to change. In 1922 Cairo, free-spirited archaeologist Danny Fremont is certain that if found, King Tut's Emerald Tablet would hold the ultimate power to control the world. But unfortunately, the only person who believes Fremont is his ruthless archaeologist nemesis Morgan Sinclair, a member of a secret society who wants the tablet to harness unspeakable evil on the world and will stop at nothing to get it and then extend their world domination. But with the help of a crackerjack team adventurers that includes the doubting egyptologist Dr. Azelia Barakat, Fremont ventures through the Valley of the Kings, toward Tut's tomb, near the portal to the underworld, and getting closer to the truth behind a mystery that will change the world forever or end it.

programme.title: Annie's Point
programme.desc: Richard Eason is flat-out filling his late father's shoes as CEO of an east Coast real estate developing company, so he can't spend nearly as much time with mother Annie and daughter Ella as they would like. Annie is dead-set on visiting a place in California where she and her late husband hoped to build their dream house and convinces Ella, who wants to drop out of school and aspires a singing career, to drive along. Ill-prepared but tempestuously stubborn, they embark on an adventurous road trip, where Ella meets hunky waiter Scott Tardy. Learning Annie needs surgery soon, Richard gives chase.

programme.title: Lives of the Saints
programme.desc: Vittorio Innocente, a young man, estranged from the tragedies of his Italian immigrant family, has spent his adult life denying his past. When his estranged father starts to stalk Vittorio's sister, Rita, with murderous intent, Vittorio is moved to return to his family and uncover the decades-old secrets that have torn his family apart.

programme.title: Fear the Walking Dead
programme.desc: In Los Angeles, a city where people come to escape, shield secrets, and bury their pasts, we follow this mysterious outbreak as it threatens to disrupt what little stability high school guidance counselor Madison Clark and English teacher Travis Manawa have managed to assemble. The pressure of blending two families while dealing with resentful, escapist, and strung out children takes a back seat when society begins to break down. A forced evolution, and survival of the fittest takes hold, as our dysfunctional family finds they must either reinvent themselves or embrace their darker histories.

programme.title: End of Days
programme.desc: Bodyguard Jericho Cane stumbles across a demonic state of affairs when he prevents the assassination of his Wall Street employer. It transpires that Cane's boss is Satan himself, come to impregnate a woman on the eve of the new millennium and so bring about the end of days foretold in the Book of Revelation. With the help of his partner, Chicago, Cane now attempts to protect Christine from both Satan and a group of priests who believe that her death is the only way to halt Armageddon.

programme.title: Good Fences
programme.desc: Good Fences is about an upwardly-mobile Black family for whom the American dream becomes a nightmare. In the 1970s, Tom Spader is an attorney who is determined to end what he has dubbed "the colored man's losing streak." When his winning of a high-profile case thrusts him into the limelight, he decides to move his wife and their two kids out of their mixed lower-middle-class town and into the posh enclave of Greenwich, Connecticut.

programme.desc: A rare first edition from a pioneer author goes missing in the mystery novels-specialized Kinsey bookshop during remodeling by the local firm of Tyler Dell, who recently lost his father, a Vietnam veteran. Retired English teacher Jim Carter, who overheard everything, is murdered shortly after a row in Reverend Tucker's homeless shelter Haven with aggressive lush Murphy. Rude police chief Connors isn't up to an investigation while the killer keeps sniping, so the bookstore's armchair sleuths duo does it alone, starting from a lacquered box left by Jim for his illegitimate daughter, who never even knew his name. It starts a set of cues, slowly unraveling a grim intrigue starting during a 1965 US illegal intrusion into Red Khmer territory.

programme.desc: While searching for a KGB double agent who was about to be exposed by another Russian spy-turned-successful author, mystery bookstore owner Samantha Kinsey and her secretive friend and store manager, Philby are thrust into the murderous world of international espionage.

programme.title: Where There's a Will
programme.desc: A hapless grifter stands to inherit a small fortune from his estranged grandmother if he travels to Harmony, Texas to live with her. Instead of a short road to easy money, he finds a soft spot in his heart for the little town and unconditional love from his only living relative.

programme.title: Out of the Woods
programme.desc: Drama with Jason London. A self-absorbed young lawyer with ties to the material things in life gets an eye-opening experience when he visits his nature-loving grandfather.

programme.title: On Thin Ice / Breaking Through
programme.desc: Patsy McCartle is a widow with two sons trying to gather all the money she has to pay for her car, bills, and her son's medication, all of which she can barely afford. Patsy then turns to dealing drugs and becomes addicted to crystal meth. Her only way of recovery rests in the hands of her children.

programme.title: DreamKeeper
programme.desc: The film opens with Eagle Boy, a young man who is on a vision quest. It then cuts to the present, where a 17-year-old Lakota named Shane Chasing Horse is living on the Pine Ridge reservation. He is in trouble because he owes some money to a local gang—money he used to buy a beautiful ring for Mae Little Wounded, a girl he likes. Meanwhile, his mother asks him to drive his grandfather, Pete Chasing Horse, a storyteller, down to the powwow. Shane is reluctant. However, when the gang comes after him, Shane changes his mind and heads out to the powwow with his grandfather, who agrees to give him his truck once they reach the powwow. Grandfather tells Shane the story of a young Lakota man who tries to win the hand of Bluebird Woman. He also tells the story of how a thunder spirit falls in love with a Mohawk woman and brings her up into the ethereal world of Sky Woman, and of how she raised their son back in her village until he was struck by one of the villagers and brought back to live with his father.

programme.title: Casanova
programme.desc: He was the world's most notorious seducer. A swashbuckler, master of disguise and wit - it was said no woman could resist Casanova's amorous charms. Until now. For the first time in his life, the legendary Casanova (Heath Ledger) is about to meet his match with an alluring Ventian beauty, Francesca (Sienna Miller), who does the one thing he never thought possible: refuse him. Through a series of clever disguises and scheming ruses, he manages to get ever closer to Francesca. But he is playing the most dangerous game he has ever encountered - one that will risk not only his life and reputation, but his only chance at true passion.

programme.title: Eurolygos rungtynės. Belgrado „Partizan" - Kauno „Žalgiris"
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: Vimbldono turnyras. Preview Show
programme.desc: Wimbledon is more than just a tennis tournament — it's a summer tradition, a slice of British culture, and one of the most iconic sporting events in the world. Held every year in London, England, usually in late June to early July, it's where the best tennis players on the planet come to battle it out on the famous grass courts of the All England Club. It's actually the oldest tennis tournament in the world, dating back to 1877, and it's still the only Grand Slam played on grass — the fastest and most unpredictable surface. That's part of what makes it so exciting. Matches are intense, fast-paced, and full of surprises. Wimbledon is packed with unique traditions that make it stand out. Players are required to wear all white on court — no exceptions. The crowd enjoys strawberries and cream, and you won't see flashy ads around the court — it's all about the game. And of course, there's the Royal Box, where you might spot celebrities or even members of the British Royal Family watching the action. From rising stars to tennis legends, everyone dreams of lifting the famous Wimbledon trophy. There's something magical about seeing players walk onto Centre Court, hearing the roar of the crowd, and witnessing moments that go down in sports history. Whether you're a tennis fan or just love great sports drama, Wimbledon is a must-watch — classy, thrilling, and full of unforgettable moments.

programme.title: Vimbldono turnyras. Preview Show
programme.desc: Wimbledon is more than just a tennis tournament — it's a summer tradition, a slice of British culture, and one of the most iconic sporting events in the world. Held every year in London, England, usually in late June to early July, it's where the best tennis players on the planet come to battle it out on the famous grass courts of the All England Club. It's actually the oldest tennis tournament in the world, dating back to 1877, and it's still the only Grand Slam played on grass — the fastest and most unpredictable surface. That's part of what makes it so exciting. Matches are intense, fast-paced, and full of surprises. Wimbledon is packed with unique traditions that make it stand out. Players are required to wear all white on court — no exceptions. The crowd enjoys strawberries and cream, and you won't see flashy ads around the court — it's all about the game. And of course, there's the Royal Box, where you might spot celebrities or even members of the British Royal Family watching the action. From rising stars to tennis legends, everyone dreams of lifting the famous Wimbledon trophy. There's something magical about seeing players walk onto Centre Court, hearing the roar of the crowd, and witnessing moments that go down in sports history. Whether you're a tennis fan or just love great sports drama, Wimbledon is a must-watch — classy, thrilling, and full of unforgettable moments.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters
programme.desc: Large carnivores such as leopards, lions and hyenas are in constant competition for their next meal for their pack in Zambia's Luangwa Valley. Following the lives of the wise old leopard Kamuti who rained over the prime territory in the Luangwa Valley for 10 years, a six-week-old lion cub and a clan of spotted hyenas, this documentary series allows audiences to see these magnificent animals like never before. With up-close imagery of animals existing within Luangwa Valley and their life in the wild, feel a part of the pack with Africa's Hunters.

Soon, the females are pregnant and new pups arrive and the whole cycle starts again.

A number of iconic species call the vast biodiversity in this country and help us to understand their natural behaviours in their habitats. Jack Spencer takes us on a journey to look at the amazing communities ranging from a pride of fearsome lions, to a herd of enormous elephants to the smaller insects and everything in between. Each episode has a main focus of one animal group or topic within Africa so for those who enjoy learning about Africa, this programme is for you.

programme.title: Built for the Kill
programme.desc: The hyena, much maligned and misunderstood, is no slobbering scavenger. It's a calculating killer: as smart as a primate, as lethal as a lion. Built for the Kill: Hyena follows the transformation of a tiny cub into an accomplished hunter; exposing real life and death struggles in dramatic second-by-second detail.

programme.title: Croc Wars: Grumeti Vs Mara

programme.title: Built for the Kill

programme.title: Prairie Dog Manor
programme.desc: Follow the exploits of these cute creatures from northern New Mexico. "Prairie Dog Manor" showcases the unique behaviour of these special animals and highlights the different relationships that exist between the clan members from Valles Caldera National Preserve. Beginning with the prairie dogs preparing for the coming winter, Carl and the pups get ready for hibernation. But they face danger from an unlikely source as deadly predators forge an alliance to threaten every dog in the territory. Further episodes explore the mating season when the warm weather arrives and battles commence between the males to earn the right to mate with the females. Soon, the females are pregnant and new pups arrive and the whole cycle starts again.

programme.title: America's Wild Spaces
programme.desc: This show explores the unbridled natural beauty of America's national parks and highlights some of the most awe-inspiring scenery on the planet. Travelling beyond the more conventional tourist hot-spots, the viewer is transported to the hidden wonders of America's wild spaces. Episodes include joining a scientific exploration of the 277 mile long Grand Canyon, studying its geological history, exploring the microscopic colonies of vegetation and examining its unique creatures; journeying through the Everglades, a 1.5 million acre home to strange creatures, carnivorous plants, amphibious birds and fish that can breathe air; and navigating across the northwest archipelago of Hawaii following a team of diving scientists as they inspect the unique aquaeous flora and fauna.

programme.title: The Hidden Kingdoms of China
programme.desc: China is the world's third biggest country by area. It has second largest economy on the planet and the largest population. But this documentary series takes you away from China's highly-populated mega-cities and explores the more remote locations of this fascinating country. Visiting forests, jungles, mountains and grasslands, we take a rare glimpse at parts of China that usually remain unseen. We see the wildlife that live amongst the stunning beauty of the Chinese landscapes - and how they survive in often demanding situations. With golden snub-nosed monkeys, bears, bees, elephants and the legendary giant panda. The Hidden Kingdoms of China is narrated by Michelle Yeoh.

We see the wildlife that live amongst the stunning beauty of the Chinese landscapes - and how they survive in often demanding situations. With golden snub-nosed monkeys, bears, bees, elephants and the legendary giant panda. The Hidden Kingdoms of China is narrated by Michelle Yeoh.

programme.title: America's Wild Spaces
programme.desc: This show explores the unbridled natural beauty of America's national parks and highlights some of the most awe-inspiring scenery on the planet. Travelling beyond the more conventional tourist hot-spots, the viewer is transported to the hidden wonders of America's wild spaces. Episodes include joining a scientific exploration of the 277 mile long Grand Canyon, studying its geological history, exploring the microscopic colonies of vegetation and examining its unique creatures; journeying through the Everglades, a 1.5 million acre home to strange creatures, carnivorous plants, amphibious birds and fish that can breathe air; and navigating across the northwest archipelago of Hawaii following a team of diving scientists as they inspect the unique aquaeous flora and fauna.

programme.title: The Sharks of Hawaii
programme.desc: National Geographic Wild. A film that will take us from the remote reefs of the Hawaiian archipelago to the world-famous beaches of Waikiki. The sharks here offer up extraordinary behaviour, some seen sowhere else on earth.

programme.title: World's Deadliest Animals
programme.desc: North America is home to an array of wild creatures…creatures that have roamed the continent for millennia. Among this myriad of species is an elite group of twelve --an assembly of animals, insects, and arachnids-- equipped with an arsenal of predator skills. Now, witness their magnificence by journeying into their inner sanctums. From the painted deserts to the coastal waterways, to the dense forests, to our own back yards…they creep, crawl, and live where we live, work, and play. The shows climax comes when we reach the animal whose size, strength or fearsome reputation looms above all others. For this superlative denizen of the natural world, we not only go in depth to examine the magnificent adaptations that have allowed it to survive and thrive, but we also hear from someone whos met it first hand, and lived to tell the story. Theyre beautiful, theyre highly evolved, and theyre dangerousthey are North Americas Deadly Dozen.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: On this special episode, accident-prone animals have the vets patching paws and curing tummy troubles. A pet duck has an eye issue, hungry cat feels the burn as he tries to sneak a snack, and a skittish horse has a self-inflicted injury. Dr. Pol performs emergency surgery after a beloved dog gets a toy stuck in his gut. A new puppy owner learns to clean up her room after her dog passes a sock in the clinic parking lot. The vets team up to pluck an endless number of quills from a pair of curious dogs. Just when the vets thought that they had seen it all, Doc is called to treat a dog and a goose after they got into a fight.

programme.title: World's Deadliest Animals
programme.desc: Our world is home to an array of wild creatures…creatures that have evolved to survive amid harsh environments, and brutal competition. But in every region resides an elite group of twelve species -- an assembly of mammals, reptiles, insects, and arachnids-- equipped with an arsenal of predatory and defensive skills. They're beautiful, they're highly evolved, and they're dangerous-they are the Deadly Dozen.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: With more than 19,000 patients, Dr. Pol has seen it all. Specializing in large farm animals, this senior is anything but retiring as he takes an old-school, non-nonsense approach to veterinary medicine. Unflappable and unstoppable, this doc routinely puts in 14-hour days and is a legend in his community. This new series travels with him across rural Michigan to care for every family pet and head of livestock in need of his expertise and kindness.

programme.title: Sky Sharks
programme.desc: In this enhanced episode, drones reveal the unexpected places where sharks and humans live fin to limb. It's time to check what's swimming behind you! Because around the world scientists are discovering that many sharks live in urban hotspots right off the beach. We join a team of Californian researchers on a mission to find why they come, and whether it spells danger at the beach.

programme.title: Shark Below Zero
programme.desc: White sharks have been spotted across Canada as far north as the coast of Newfoundland. After the first suspected white shark attack in Canada for over 150 years, experts Greg Skomal, Heather Bowlby, Megan Winton & Warren Joyce, investigate what drives white sharks journey to the very Northern limit of their range.

programme.title: World's Deadliest Animals
programme.desc: Australia, a continent unto itself…home to scores of creatures found nowhere else in the world. programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: Feline Fervor: King Julien is literally bounced out of his kingdom and onto the New York streets. A kindly old lady thinks he's a cat and swoops him up. He's encroaching on another's turf, though - the apartment's already home to a feline-impersonator, a female ferret named Zoe. Julien is taken with Zoe, and puts on his best seduction moves. Will the street-smart ferret succumb to his kingly charms? Smart money says… you never know! Action Reaction: Skipper is forced to live his worst nightmare when he's doused with Inflatium and stress causes him to blow up like a balloon. Guess what this means… no more going on missions! Sitting behind a desk doing paperwork instead! Hans takes advantage of the situation and targets a massive weapons lab, and without Skipper the penguins are easily captured. How can Skipper combat the evil puffin if he's in a puffy state?

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: The Penguins of Madagascar is an American animated television series, a spin-off of the Madagascar films. The main characters are penguins-commandoes: Skipper, Rico, Kowalski, and Private. They pretend to be white and fluffy but in reality are fearless adrenaline addicts and a secret spy team on a mission to protect their home in the Central Park Zoo. The penguins often have to deal with problems caused by their zoo lemur neighbors- King Julien XIII, Maurice and Mort. The penguins thwart any attempts of King Julien XIII to wield the sceptre of the Zoo.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: Mental Hen: Kowalski has a rival, if you even can call it a rivalry. A Delaware Blue Hen has taken up residence at the zoo, and she has the amazing ability to predict the future! Kowalski doesn't buy the psychic chicken hype and sets out to discredit her. The truth turns out to be far more sinister than a simple sports-pickin' chicken, and Kowalski will have to use all his best moves to wiggle out of this mess. Thumb Drive: The penguins need a thumb, and Maurice's fits the bill nicely. Using the opposable digit thumbprint to break into a secret weapons lab gets the penguins all atwitter. King Julien is unhappy that his right hand man is running around on missions with the birds so he sets out to sabotage the mission. As with most of King Julien's plans, this scheme turns out to be "thumbs down"!

With Mumblin now on their side, Max and co. attempt to rescue Uncle Budrick, but when a tentacled creature emerges from the moat, Max and the others must flee without Uncle Budrick. All other characters such as Mr. Krabs, Mrs. Puff, SpongeBob's nemesis Plankton, and Karen are a part of this adventure as well.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

programme.desc: Best Foes: Kowalski invents an enemy detector. As is often the case, it doesn't work, and Skipper gets his own wires crossed when he smashes it. Old enemies are now friends and old friends are now enemies as the boss bird starts to systematically clean out the zoo with the help of his new friend Hans. King Julien gets into the act by becoming Skipper's friend too, going so far as to Congaga dance together. New BFF Hans is not happy with the new bromance, however. Could this be the opening the penguins need? Night of the Vesuviuses: The annual Zoo Snooze is here! Kids get to buy tickets for a zoo sleepover, a treat the animals look forward to every year! This year's going to be very different, however, when the rotten Vesuvius Twins buy up all the tickets themselves. The zoosters plan to turn the tables, though, and exact sweet revenge on the twins. The penguins, influenced by Private of course, can't let this happen, and it's a long night's journey into day as the penguins scramble to protect their one-time tormentors.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: This is a story of a simple innocent guy Bijoy (Jeet). He came to Kolkata with his brother. Bijoy met with Puja (Koyel Mallick). Koyel gave shelter to them. Bijoy admitted his brother to Puja's school with the help of Puja. On the other side two anti-socials Bablu Koley (Shankar Chakroborty) & Bindu Masi (Anamika Saha) competing each other for the upcoming vote. Binoy Samanta (Rajatava Dutta) supported Bablu for election. Puja's father Sattabroto Roy (Bodhisatto Majumdar) threatened Bindu Masi. Bindu Masi killed Sattabroto. Bijoy's brother Raju was the only witness of this murder. Puja advised Bijoy to leave the place, but he did not agree. Binu Masi & Bablu Koley tried to kidnap Raju and Raju died. Munna was arrested by Ranabir Roy (Tapas Pal). But Bindu released her brother. Ranabir was suspended. Bijoy killed Munna. Bijoy married Puja. Bijoy killed Bablu Koley. Bindu masi tried to kill Puja, but Bijoy saved her. Binoy told the truth to the press, and Bindu masi killed Binoy.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Gullible Pants: SpongeBob is left in charge of the Krusty Krab while Mr. Krabs steps out for 15 minutes, and he is determined to make it the best-managed 15 minutes ever! So when Squidward tells him that there are a lot of rules that he doesn't know about-like never interrupting Squidward's naps-SpongeBob is eager to learn and follow everything he says. Overbooked: SpongeBob's got a full day, and he's determined to do everything he's scheduled to do: help fix Mr. Krabs' telescope, go to Patrick's birthday party, and help with Sandy's science presentation. Too bad everything's scheduled for the same exact time!

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: No Hat for Pat: Patrick is sick of all of his friends not being able to play with him because they have to put on their Krusty Krab hats and go to work. So when Mr. Krabs offers him a job as a sign-holder, Patrick is thrilled because it means he gets to wear a hat and work with all his friends! But Pat soon learns that wearing a hat isn't as simple as it looks. Toy Store of Doom: A new toy store has opened up in Bikini Bottom, and SpongeBob and Patrick couldn't be happier! In fact, they are having so much fun at the toy store that they accidentally get locked in when it closes. They soon find out that things are a lot different at the toy store when no one's around...

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Raphael's brothers just don't understand him. Not only does he NEED to fight, he's really good at it, or at least that's what his new boxing trainer named Spuds told him. Spuds even ENCOURAGES Raph to work out his anger and negativity through fighting, even if his family and the annoying Pigeon Pete don't get it. But although the Turtles don't see eye to eye, they must work together to stop a rampaging Rocksteady and Bebop from wrecking the city! Social media blew up with videos of the two Mutanimals going berserk, fighting each other without seeming to know what was going on around them. And all the while, doing some serious damage to the city! As the dust settles, is there someone behind the whole plot, pulling the strings?

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: All of Raph's wildest dreams are coming true in the underground Mutant Battle Arena! He gets to let loose, fighting the massive Mutanimals Bebop and Rocksteady; even the hug-loving Mondo Gecko joins in on the fun! Raph doesn't hold back, and he gets his butt kicked with a smile on his face. Not only that, he's getting some serious bling in exchange for being part of the fights - gold chains, new clothes, even his very own vehicle, the TURTLE TANK! This makes Donnie, Leo, and Mikey very suspicious, since Raph has kept everything a secret from them. But audiences love Raph, which pleases the crime boss Kitsune and her street gang, the Purple Dragons. They run the arena with the help of an obnoxious investor named Knox. But Raph's dream may become a nightmare, as Raph is oblivious to the fact that he's walked right into their trap!

programme.title: Transformers: Earthspark
programme.desc: In a world where the Autobots and Decepticons are fighting...Read more for power, a new breed of mutants is caught between the two. These young robots are trying to figure out where they fit in the universe.

programme.title: Top Wing
programme.desc: Best friends and cadets-in-training Swift, Penny, Rod, and Brody congregate at Top Wing Academy, where they learn what it takes to gain their wings and become rescue birds on Big Swirl Island. Swift is a blue jay and the fastest pilot at the academy; Penny, the only female in the group, is a penguin, and she is an expert at undersea life; Brody is a puffin who takes a more land approach, and Rod is a rooster who is ready to fly around Big Swirl Island in his all-terrain vehicle. The four friends are joined by their mentor Speedy, who helps the cadets on their different missions. "Top Wing" focuses on the importance of teamwork and the ability to successfully solve problems.

programme.desc: "Pet's Peeved: The notorious Vesuvius Twins have adopted Skipper and King Julien and brought the animal's home to their luxury apartment. programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: Private has an arch enemy in the form of Dale the snail. Why does this snail hate Private so much? It's because Private allegedly smashed the little guy, and keeps smashing him albeit accidentally. Even a public apology ends with Dale getting crushed. Sadly, Dale should never have been enemies with Private to begin with - it was a different penguin who did him wrong. // King Julien becomes enamored of a giant toilet the penguins have built. He wants to use it as his new throne, only the toilet is actually a stink bomb the penguins built to trap Dr. Blowhole. Julien accidently gets trapped, bound tightly to the bomb, so the penguins must try to stop it from detonating, all while going on a wild truck chase through New York. They end up in a New Jersey dump, and Skipper must show a sensitive side before all is lost.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents: A New Wish
programme.desc: Hazel and Jasmine have planned their very first sleepover but Dev Dimmadome threatens to throw an even better party! To draw her classmates' attention Hazel boasts that she lives in a luxury hotel and wishes her apartment building into The Wellsington Hotelsington Hotel. Now she must balance running the hottest hotel in Dimmadelphia and spending time with Jasmine and Winn before they check out of the friendship! // Hoping to win a class superlative, Hazel wishes to be famous at her school. Father Time cuts her a deal for 1,500 minutes of fame, but Principal Krentz is not happy about Hazel's celebrity status and threatens to transfer her if she doesn't stop being a "distraction" by the end of lunch. With tons of time left on her wish, Nick of Time arrives with a solution: if Hazel acts like a New Yorker, her remaining minutes will turn into New York Minutes and pass faster. Can Hazel act New Yorky enough to beat the clock?

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents: A New Wish
programme.desc: It's picture day at school! And on top of that, they're serving the most delicious pudding at lunchtime! Only problem is, Dev has control of the pudding supply and is hoarding it. Hazel takes the power back by wishing that everyone had an unlimited supply of pudding. Pudding is everywhere and Dev is out of business! But things take a turn when people can't stop eating it and turn into pudding zombies. Now Hazel not only has to save picture day, but also stop a pudding apocalypse! // Hoping to win "Most Spirited Hair" for School Spirit Week, Hazel wishes her hair had spirit! Cosmo and Wanda take this literally and give her hair a spirit, bringing it to life as Diana the Diva! When Hazel and Diana "butt heads" over how best to showcase her, Diana runs away. Hazel chases her all over town but can't catch her. Later, Diana shows up at Hazel's school aiming to enter the contest on her own. Hazel must find a way to reconcile with Diana if she hopes to win Diana back and win the contest.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents: A New Wish
programme.desc: When Cosmo and Wanda grant a wish to make Hazel's potato project work for the Science Fair, they rewrite the rules of science for the whole universe! When the physical world goes haywire as a result, they can't undo it because not even their magic is not working correctly! And Sci, the Science Fairy, refuses to help Hazel because he does not approve of her shortcut. Hazel must learn the real science behind her potato project to power up Cosmo and Wanda's wands and set the universe right again. // After watching a detective TV show with her dad, Hazel wishes she could solve a mystery like a genuine gumshoe. At first, she is wrapped up in the thrill of solving a mystery, but things get real when the landlord goes missing. Everyone is a suspect - kids at school, the strange new neighbors, and even Cosmo and Wanda! Things intensify when Hazel suspects her family is the next target. In a dramatic climax at dinner at her neighbors', Hazel unveils the truth. Is it foul play? Or is it just her imagination?

He stumbles onto a jackpot oak tree which is loaded with acorns (that's tons of money to animal folk). He's going to need financial advice, and who better to offer sound advice than King Julien? The two enter a partnership looking for ways to spend on the good life. The Red Squirrel has designs on the loot, though, and captures the hapless twosome in order to squeeze the acorns out of them. Will the evil squirrel's precisely planned plot pay or get him played? The Terror of Madagascar: A special delivery has come from Madagascar. What is it? A baby Fossa! Everyone is enchanted by the little tyke except King Julien, who sees him as a lemur-devouring predator, and he has the toothmarks on his butt to prove it! Julien formulates a plan to get rid of the adorable little carnivore, but his slithery solution becomes much worse than the problem!

programme.title: Best & Bester
programme.desc: Best and Bester are a pair of hilariously individual twins who live in a weird and wonderful alternate reality where your neighbour could be a pair of disgruntled trousers or your best friend a floating cloud of bottom burp. But, unlike their friends and neighbours, Best and Bester have the unique ability to choose a new body every single day and, in doing so, experience life in a completely different way.

programme.desc: La storia del banchiere gentile Ennio Doris, fondatore di Banca Mediolanum. Da ragazzo che aveva un sogno a uomo d'oro della finanza italiana.

programme.title: Amata
programme.desc: Due donne affrontano lotte opposte per la fertilità: la giovane Nunzia è alle prese con una gravidanza indesiderata e desidera giorni spensierati, mentre Maddalena, a 40 anni, cerca disperatamente di concepire un figlio.

programme.title: Le ali della libertà
programme.desc: Tim Robbins e Morgan Freeman nel dramma carcerario tratto da Stephen King. Mentre sogna la fuga, un bancario condannato per omicidio stringe una grande amicizia con un altro detenuto.

programme.title: Non ci resta che piangere
programme.desc: Un maestro elementare e un bidello si ritrovano, per uno strano scherzo del caso, nel 1492. Decidono di recarsi a Palos, in Andalusia, per fermare Cristoforo Colombo e impedirgli di scoprire le Americhe.

programme.title: The Independent: Complotto per la Casa Bianca
programme.desc: John Cena e Brian Cox nella pellicola targata Sky Original. Una giovane giornalista scopre una cospirazione che coinvolge un candidato alla Presidenza degli Stati Uniti.

programme.title: Limonov
programme.desc: Dal romanzo di Emmanuel Carrère, Kirill Serebrennikov dirige un film sulla travolgente vita dello scrittore e politico Eduard Limonov (Ben Whishaw) tra Russia, America ed Europa.

programme.title: Rush
programme.desc: Ron Howard dirige Chris Hemsworth e Daniel Bruhl nel biopic sulla rivalita' fra i piloti James Hunt e Niki Lauda, protagonisti di una memorabile stagione della Formula Uno.

programme.title: La Grande Bellezza - Versione Integrale
programme.desc: Jep Gambardella, giornalista affermato, si muove tra i palazzi della Roma mondana in cui si celano vizio e degenerazione...

programme.title: No Other Choice - Non c'è altra scelta
programme.desc: Le contraddizioni della società coreana nel film di Park Chan-wook presentato a Venezia. Licenziato dopo 25 anni, un uomo vede andare in frantumi la sua vita "perfetta".

programme.title: Il talento di Mr. Ripley
programme.desc: Matt Damon, Jude Law e Gwyneth Paltrow nel thriller dal romanzo di Patricia Highsmith. Incaricato di riportare a casa il figlio di un magnate, un uomo e' coinvolto in un tragico intrigo.

programme.title: Giurato numero 2
programme.desc: Nicholas Hoult e Toni Collette in un legal-thriller di Clint Eastwood. Durante un processo per omicidio, uno dei giurati scopre di essere l'involontario colpevole del delitto. Sconvolto dal senso di colpa, cerca di scagionare l'imputato senza rivelare la propria responsabilità.

programme.title: Sentimental Value
programme.desc: Nora e Agnes, due sorelle molto unite, si ritrovano a dover affrontare il ritorno del padre, regista carismatico ma assente nelle loro vite. L'uomo desidera realizzare il suo ultimo film e includere una delle figlie nel progetto.

programme.title: Il campione
programme.desc: Emozionante pellicola di Leonardo D'Agostini con Stefano Accorsi e Andrea Carpenzano. Per disciplinare un giovane fuoriclasse, il presidente gli affianca un insegnante privato.

programme.title: Gioia mia
programme.desc: Gioia, un'insegnante di letteratura francese, instaura un legame proibito, fragile e inspiegabilmente necessario con Alessio, un suo studente. Quest'ultimo però distrugge tutto e cancella l'unica persona che lo abbia mai amato.

programme.title: House of the Dragon
programme.sub-title: Sale E Mare, Fuoco E Sangue
programme.desc: Spinta dalla fiducia che ripone in Alicent, Rhaenyra si prepara a conquistare Approdo del Re mentre la Triarchia salpa per affrontare Corlys nella Gola.

programme.title: Joker: Folie à Deux
programme.desc: Joaquin Phoenix riveste i panni del folle personaggio della DC Comics in uno sbalorditivo sequel con Lady Gaga. Internato nel manicomio di Arkham in attesa del processo per i crimini commessi, Arthur Fleck si innamora di Lee Quinzel, una paziente affascinata dalla figura del Joker.

programme.title: Dumb Money
programme.desc: Diretto da Craig Gillespie, il financial drama che ripercorre il caso GameStop, l'azienda salvata da un gruppo di investitori amatoriali a discapito di un gruppo di speculatori di Wall Street.

programme.title: Mrs Lowry & Son
programme.desc: Timothy Spall e Vanessa Redgrave nella biografia del pittore britannico L. S. Lowry. Figlio di una donna che scoraggia quotidianamente le sue ambizioni, l’aspirante artista lavora ogni giorno con l’obiettivo di dipingere un quadro che possa rendere la madre fiera di lui.

programme.title: The Wolf of Wall Street
programme.desc: Golden Globe a Leonardo DiCaprio nel biopic di Martin Scorsese con Margot Robbie. L'incredibile ascesa di Jordan Belfort, un broker attratto dalla sete di potere e da una vita dissoluta.

programme.title: Into the Wild - Nelle terre selvagge
programme.desc: Le musiche di Eddie Vedder e la regia di Sean Penn per un film che celebra la ricerca della liberta'. Un diciottenne lascia agi e vincoli familiari per un intimo viaggio a contatto con la natura.

programme.title: Il professore e il pinguino
programme.desc: Un insegnante di inglese disilluso si reca in Argentina nel 1976 per insegnare. Si trova di fronte a una classe di ragazzi turbolenti e a un Paese nel caos. Quando salva un pinguino da una spiaggia inquinata dal petrolio, tutto cambia.

programme.title: Argo
programme.desc: 3 Oscar e 2 Golden Globe al thriller diretto e interpretato da Ben Affleck. Iran, 1979: uno specialista della Cia attua un geniale piano per liberare un gruppo di ostaggi.

programme.title: Eiffel
programme.desc: Appassionante Sky Original con Romain Duris ed Emma Mackey. Parigi, 1889: l'incontro con una donna amata in passato ispira Gustave Eiffel nella costruzione della celebre torre.

programme.title: Will Hunting - Genio ribelle
programme.desc: Oscar a Robin Williams e alla sceneggiatura per il capolavoro di Gus Van Sant con Matt Damon e Ben Affleck. Un genio allo sbando incontra uno psicologo. La sua vita cambierà per sempre.

programme.title: La magnifica Lillian Hall
programme.desc: Jessica Lange, Kathy Bates, Jesse Williams e Pierce Brosnan nella toccante pellicola che racconta il crepuscolo di una diva di Broadway.

programme.title: Codice d'onore
programme.desc: Tom Cruise sfida Jack Nicholson in un dramma giudiziario con Demi Moore e Kevin Bacon. Tre avvocati militari difendono due marines accusati dell'omicidio di un commilitone.

programme.title: La battaglia di Hacksaw Ridge
programme.desc: 2 Oscar al War movie di Mel Gibson con Andrew Garfield, da una storia vera. Seconda guerra mondiale: un soldato ottiene la medaglia al valore malgrado il rifiuto di impugnare le armi.

programme.title: Il quadro rubato
programme.desc: André Masson, esperto di arte moderna, riceve una lettera in cui si dice che un dipinto di Egon Schiele è stato trovato a Mulhouse. Dell'opera era scomparsa ogni traccia ormai dal 1939.

programme.title: Old Boy
programme.desc: Gran Premio della Giuria a Cannes per il film pulp di Park Chan-Wook. Un uomo, segregato in una stanza per quindici anni, cerca vendetta nei confronti del suo sconosciuto aguzzino.

programme.title: I segreti di Wind River
programme.desc: Jeremy Renner ed Elizabeth Olsen in un thriller premiato a Cannes. Un cacciatore collabora con una giovane agente dell'FBI per scoprire il killer di una ragazza nativo-americana.

programme.title: Questo o quello - Speciale
programme.desc: Francesco Castelnuovo e Gianni Canova ci parlano dei film 'Un bel giorno' e Una di famiglia - The Housemaid' e della serie 'The Miniature Wife - Un piccolo problema'.

programme.title: Il Padrino: Epilogo - La morte di Michael Corleone
programme.desc: Capitolo finale della trilogia, restaurato e rimontato da Francis Ford Coppola. Il sessantenne Mike Corleone individua in Vincent il successore del suo impero criminale.

programme.title: Ave, Cesare!
programme.desc: Siamo nei primi anni 50, Eddie Mannix è impegnato a risolvere tutti i problemi degli attori e registi della Capitol Pictures. I suoi ultimi incarichi comprendono un regista scontento, un cowboy cantante, un bel nuotatore e un affascinante ballerino.

programme.title: Codice d'onore
programme.desc: Tom Cruise sfida Jack Nicholson in un dramma giudiziario con Demi Moore e Kevin Bacon. Tre avvocati militari difendono due marines accusati dell'omicidio di un commilitone.

programme.title: Il Maestro
programme.desc: Estate, fine anni Ottanta. Un ex tennista, deluso dalla sua mediocre carriera, diventa l'allenatore di un giovane talento timido, schiacciato dalle aspettative del padre. I due affrontano le loro paure e insicurezze.

programme.title: Donnie Brasco
programme.desc: Johnny Depp e Al Pacino immensi interpreti di un avvincente gangster-movie. Un agente FBI conquista la fiducia di un anziano mafioso, nascondendo la sua identita' fino all'ultimo.

programme.title: Django Unchained
programme.desc: 2 Oscar e 2 Golden Globe al western di Quentin Tarantino con Christoph Waltz, Jamie Foxx e Leonardo DiCaprio. Uno schiavo nero riacquista la liberta' e corre a salvare anche sua moglie.

programme.title: Cry Macho - Ritorno a casa
programme.desc: Road movie di ambientazione western di e con Clint Eastwood, dal romanzo di N. Richard Nash. Una vecchia gloria dei rodei accetta di riportare in Texas il figlio del suo ex capo.

programme.title: Anora
programme.desc: 5 Oscar e Palma d'oro a Cannes alla travolgente commedia di Sean Baker con Mikey Madison e Mark Eydelshteyn. Una spogliarellista di New York sposa il figlio miliardario di un oligarca russo, ma i suoceri inviano i loro sgherri negli Stati Uniti per annullare il matrimonio.

programme.title: Red Rocket
programme.desc: Trovandosi in difficoltà a Los Angeles, l'ex pornostar Mikey Saber decide di tornare nella città natale di Texas City, dove nessuno sembra particolarmente entusiasta di rivederlo.

programme.title: Questo o quello - Speciale
programme.desc: Francesco Castelnuovo e Gianni Canova ci parlano dei film 'Un bel giorno' e Una di famiglia - The Housemaid' e della serie 'The Miniature Wife - Un piccolo problema'.

programme.title: Lady Vendetta
programme.desc: Ingiustamente incarcerata per l'omicidio di un bambino, una donna fa della vendetta verso i veri colpevoli la sua ragione di vita.

programme.title: Star Trek - Il futuro ha inizio
programme.desc: Dal regista di "Star Wars - Il risveglio della forza", J.J. Abrams, il reboot di un'altra leggendaria saga di fantascienza con un equipaggio di giovani star. A bordo della nave spaziale Enterprise, Kirk e Spock affrontano la loro prima missione. Oscar per il miglior trucco.

programme.title: Into Darkness - Star Trek
programme.desc: Secondo capitolo firmato J.J. Abrams della saga reboot. Il Capitano Kirk deve sconfiggere il terribile Khan - un superuomo geneticamente modificato - e fermare i folli piani di Marcus.

programme.title: Star Trek Beyond
programme.desc: Justin Lin dirige il terzo capitolo della saga reboot prodotta da J.J. Abrams. Negli angoli remoti dello spazio, un nuovo e misterioso nemico attende l'equipaggio dell'Enterprise.

programme.title: Bud Spencer & Terence Hill
programme.desc: Francesco Castelnuovo e Gianni Canova si confrontano a colpi di film iconici del leggendario duo, disponibili su Sky Cinema e Sky On Demand.

programme.title: Bud Spencer & Terence Hill
programme.desc: Francesco Castelnuovo e Gianni Canova si confrontano a colpi di film iconici del leggendario duo, disponibili su Sky Cinema e Sky On Demand.

programme.title: Miami supercops: I poliziotti dell'8a strada
programme.desc: Doug e Steve sono grandi amici: il primo lavora per l'FBI, il secondo ha lasciato l'agenzia perché nauseato dalla burocrazia che, secondo lui, lega le mani alla giustizia. La riapertura di un caso, però, richiede l'esperienza e l'astuzia di entrambi.

programme.title: ... altrimenti ci arrabbiamo!
programme.desc: Bud e Kid si vendicano di un criminale i cui scagnozzi hanno distrutto la loro nuova dune buggy. Dietro l'episodio, però, si celano losche manovre per una speculazione edilizia e le scarse capacità di uno psicologo tedesco.

programme.title: Bud Spencer & Terence Hill
programme.desc: Francesco Castelnuovo e Gianni Canova si confrontano a colpi di film iconici del leggendario duo, disponibili su Sky Cinema e Sky On Demand.

programme.title: Non c'e' due senza quattro
programme.desc: Due uomini, uno stuntman e un sassofonista, prendono il posto di due miliardari minacciati di morte da dei sicari.

programme.title: Banana Joe
programme.desc: Banana Joe svolge il suo commercio di banane che scambia con altri prodotti per i suoi protetti, gli indigeni del villaggio. Un giorno arriva un boss della malavita che vorrebbe impiantare una industria, colonizzazione di Amantido...

programme.title: Pari e dispari
programme.desc: Il guardiamarina Johnny Firpo viene incaricato dai suoi superiori di indagare su una banda di allibratori clandestini operanti in Florida. Dato che egli ignora quasi tutto del gioco, verrà affiancato da qualcuno che, invece, ne sappia.

programme.title: Chi Trova Un Amico Trova Un Tesoro
programme.desc: Alan e Charlie si recano su un'isola del Pacifico per cercare di un misterioso tesoro risalente alla seconda guerra mondiale. Giunti sul posto, i due scoprono ben presto di dover competere con altri uomini cacciatori di tesori.

programme.title: Nati CON La Camicia
programme.desc: Rosco Fraker è uno stravagante ventriloquo che gira il mondo in pattini a rotelle, Doug O'Riordan un ex detenuto dal pugno facile e il cuore tenero, appena uscito di galera. I due si incontrano in un bar, nel bel mezzo di una rissa.

programme.title: Bud Spencer & Terence Hill
programme.desc: Francesco Castelnuovo e Gianni Canova si confrontano a colpi di film iconici del leggendario duo, disponibili su Sky Cinema e Sky On Demand.

programme.title: I Due Superpiedi Quasi Piatti
programme.desc: Ladruncoli dal cuore buono, il furbo Matt e il massiccio Wilbur, un giorno si trovano casualmente arruolati nella polizia. Con Terence Hill e Bud Spencer. Regia di E. Barboni; ITA 1977.

programme.title: ... altrimenti ci arrabbiamo!
programme.desc: Bud e Kid si vendicano di un criminale i cui scagnozzi hanno distrutto la loro nuova dune buggy. Dietro l'episodio, però, si celano losche manovre per una speculazione edilizia e le scarse capacità di uno psicologo tedesco.

programme.title: Questo o quello - Speciale
programme.desc: Francesco Castelnuovo e Gianni Canova si confrontano sulle pellicole prodotte da Illumination.

programme.title: Chi ha incastrato Babbo Natale?
programme.desc: Alessandro Siani dirige e interpreta una commedia con Christian De Sica, Diletta Leotta e Angela Finocchiaro. Per far fallire Babbo Natale, un'azienda infiltra un truffatore al Polo Nord.

programme.title: Hotel Transylvania
programme.desc: Blockbuster di Halloween per tutta la famiglia. Il Conte Dracula organizza una festa per il compleanno della figlia Mavis, ma tra gli ospiti c'e' un intruso...

programme.title: Sonic 3 - Il film
programme.desc: Jim Carrey e James Marsden nel terzo capitolo dell'avvincente saga che fonde animazione e live action. Shadow, un nuovo nemico dai poteri smisurati, fa il suo ingresso in scena, costringendo Sonic, Knuckles e Tails a stringere un'alleanza con l'odiato Robotnik per salvare la Terra.

programme.title: E.T. L'extra-terrestre
programme.desc: 4 Oscar all'emozionante capolavoro di fantascienza di Steven Spielberg. Un bambino protegge dagli scienziati un alieno rimasto sulla Terra e lo aiuta a tornare sul suo pianeta.

programme.title: Shrek
programme.desc: Oscar 2002 all'animazione che ha rivoluzionato il mondo delle favole. Un orco verde, scorbutico ma dal cuore buono, deve liberare una principessa che nasconde un segreto.

programme.title: Madagascar 3: Ricercati in Europa
programme.desc: Terza avventura e nuovo continente per il leone Alex, la zebra Marty, la giraffa Melman e l'ippopotamo Gloria, che si troveranno in Europa braccati dalla spietata agente DuBois.

programme.title: Tom & Jerry
programme.desc: Le origini di una storica rivalità in una pellicola che mescola animazione classica e live action. Il topo Jerry si trasferisce in un hotel di New York per assistere alle nozze del secolo, costringendo l'organizzatore dell'evento ad assumere il gatto Tom per liberarsene.

programme.title: L'ultimo dominatore dell'aria
programme.desc: Dal regista de "Il sesto senso" un'avventura imperdibile per gli amanti del fantasy. Un bambino di 10 anni scopre di essere l'incarnazione di una divinità, dotato di poteri straordinari e con una missione da predestinato: fermare la sanguinosa guerra che oppone da un secolo la Nazione del Fuoco ai regni di Acqua, Aria e Terra. Adattamento della serie a cartoni "Avatar - la leggenda di Aang", doveva essere il primo film di una trilogia, poi mai realizzata. Formidabile la fotografia di Andrew Lesnie, premio Oscar per "Il signore degli anelli - La compagnia dell'anello".

programme.title: Un bel giorno

programme.desc: L'incredibile storia d'amicizia tra un ragazzino ribelle e un'orca. Incaricato della pulizia di un acquario, Jesse fa amicizia con Willy, un'orca capace di mirabolanti esibizioni.

programme.title: L'evocazione - The Conjuring
programme.desc: Patrick Wilson e Vera Farmiga nel primo capitolo della saga horror su una coppia di indagatori dell'occulto, che entrano in azione per fermare una terribile strega nel New England degli anni 70. La famiglia Perron - padre, madre e cinque figlie femmine - si e' appena trasferita in una nuova casa in campagna dove sono stati accolti da rumori inquietanti e strane apparizioni, che ben presto degenerano in vere e proprie manifestazioni paranormali. Terrorizzati, i coniugi Perron chiedono aiuto a due investigatori specializzati nella lotta contro presenze demoniache.

programme.desc: Al Pacino e Alicia Witt in un thriller mozzafiato diretto da Jon Avnet. Una misteriosa telefonata costringe uno psichiatra forense a una disperata corsa contro il tempo.

Lo scetticismo e il pensiero razionale non sembrano arginare il suo terrore perché chiunque altro abbia scaricato la stessa app muore nel momento indicato sul display. Quale mistero soprannaturale si nasconde dietro questo macabro fenomeno? Ed è possibile cambiare il proprio destino? Quinn ha poco tempo per cercare la risposta.

programme.desc: Deluso da una donna e salvato dalle donne. Succede ad un aspirante scrittore che rompe con la fidanzata storica e si rifugia insieme al suo cuore infranto nel paese della nonna. Nuovi incontri gli faranno tornare la voglia di innamorarsi.

programme.title: Settembre
programme.desc: 2 David di Donatello all'opera prima di Giulia Steigerwalt con Fabrizio Bentivoglio e Barbara Ronchi. Al ritorno dalle vacanze si snodano i destini di tre personaggi pronti a cambiare vita.

programme.title: Il Sapore Del Successo
programme.desc: Bradley Cooper e Sienna Miller in una 'commedia gastronomica'. Dopo essersi rovinato la carriera facendo uso di droghe, un rinomato chef torna a Londra per aprire un ristorante.

programme.title: Sai che c'è di nuovo?
programme.desc: Madonna e Rupert Everett in una commedia di John Schlesinger. Una maestra di yoga e un giardiniere gay, amici per la pelle, fanno sesso dopo una notte di euforia e lei rimane incinta...

programme.title: Downton Abbey - Il gran finale
programme.desc: Nel terzo capitolo della saga tratta dall'omonimo period drama televisivo, gli aristocratici Crawley affrontano lo scandalo pubblico scoppiato per il divorzio di Lady Mary, candidata a prendere in mano le redini della famiglia.

programme.title: La rivolta delle ex
programme.desc: Matthew McConaughey e Jennifer Garner in una commedia romantica dal tocco soprannaturale. Connor Mead è un celebre fotografo che ha un enorme fascino sulle donne: nessuna riesce a resistergli, e lui da cinico playboy passa da un'avventura all'altra. Per lui non esistono relazioni stabili, tanto meno il matrimonio. E di questo cerca di convincere anche il fratello minore, che invece sta per sposarsi, ma i fantasmi delle sue numerose ex cominciano a perseguitarlo, mostrandogli quello che sarà il suo futuro. Nel cast, anche Michael Douglas.

programme.title: La cena perfetta
programme.desc: Salvatore Esposito e Greta Scarano in una commedia sulla voglia di riscatto. Incaricato da un boss camorrista di gestire un ristorante a Roma, Carmine assume Consuelo, chef molto grintosa.

programme.title: Piccolo corpo
programme.desc: Esordio alla regia di Laura Samani, premiata ai David di Donatello. Dopo aver perso sua figlia alla nascita, Agata parte alla volta di un santuario per battezzare la sua creatura.

programme.title: Bud Spencer & Terence Hill
programme.desc: Francesco Castelnuovo e Gianni Canova si confrontano a colpi di film iconici del leggendario duo, disponibili su Sky Cinema e Sky On Demand.

programme.title: Blue Jasmine
programme.desc: Oscar e Golden Globe a Cate Blanchett in una pellicola di Woody Allen. Una donna in crisi lascia New York e si trasferisce a San Francisco per rimettere ordine nella sua vita.

programme.title: La stanza accanto
programme.desc: Tilda Swinton e Julianne Moore in un dramma di Pedro Almodovar, Leone d'Oro a Venezia. Martha è una reporter di guerra malata di cancro che ha deciso di suicidarsi con una pillola. Ingrid, una sua amica di infanzia, passa con lei gli ultimi giorni prima del momento fatale.

programme.title: Diamanti
programme.desc: Ferzan Ozpetek firma il suo maggior successo con un maestoso cast al femminile. Un regista convoca le sue attrici preferite: vuole fare un film sulle donne ma non svela altro.

programme.title: La notte più lunga dell'anno
programme.desc: Dramma corale con Ambra Angiolini. Potenza: attorno a un'area di servizio, la notte del solstizio d'inverno diventa il punto di svolta per un politico, una cubista e un gruppo di ragazzi.

programme.title: Collateral Beauty
programme.desc: Will Smith è la star di un commovente dramma sul dolore e la perdita. Segnato dalla morte della figlia, Howard, un pubblicitario di New York, si chiude in se stesso perdendo ogni interesse per cio' che lo circonda. L'unica sua reazione concreta consiste nella scrittura di lettere indirizzate alla Morte, al Tempo e all'Amore. Ai suoi amici non resta che assecondarlo mentre escogitano un piano per aiutarlo a riprendere in mano la propria vita. Dal regista de "Il diavolo veste Prada". Cast da tappeto rosso: Edward Norton, Keira Knightley, Naomie Harris e i premi Oscar Helen Mirren e Kate Winslet.

programme.title: Tartarughe all'infinito
programme.desc: Aza Holmes, sedicenne affetta da disturbo ossessivo compulsivo e ansia, indaga sulla scomparsa di un miliardario, che è anche il padre di un suo vicino di casa.

programme.desc: 3 Oscar, 3 Golden Globe e Leone d'argento alla regia di Brady Corbet che dirige Adrien Brody, Felicity Jones e Guy Pearce. Un architetto ebreo e sua moglie, sopravvissuti all'Olocausto, lasciano l'Ungheria per emigrare negli Stati Uniti. Un facoltoso cliente cambierà le loro vite.

programme.desc: Andrea Carpenzano nel film Sky Original di Francesco Lettieri. L'ascesa e il declino di Nic, in arte Lovely Boy, astro nascente della scena musicale romana finito nel baratro della droga.

programme.title: Malamore
programme.desc: Giulia Schiavo, Simone Susinna e Antonella Carone in un melodramma crime di Francesca Schirru. Una ragazza trova il coraggio di troncare la sua relazione tossica con il pregiudicato Nunzio, sposato con una capoclan, ma l'uomo esce di prigione e decide di vendicarsi.

programme.desc: Dramma sociale di Massimiliano Bruno con Paola Cortellesi e Alessandro Gassmann. La vita di una donna, licenziata perche' incinta, si intreccia con quella di un poliziotto tormentato.

programme.desc: Maria Chiara Giannetta e Francesco di Napoli in fuga attraverso l’Italia: un dietro le quinte svela retroscena, location e scene action della serie.

programme.desc: Benedetta Porcaroli e' Maria e Alessandro Gassmann e' Giuseppe nella pellicola Sky Original diretta da Paolo Zucca e tratta dall'omonimo romanzo di Barbara Alberti.

programme.title: Southpaw - L'ultima sfida
programme.desc: Avvincente dramma sul mondo della boxe con Jack Gyllenhaal e Rachel McAdams. Caduto in disgrazia dopo un incidente, un pugile deve tornare sul ring per ottenere la custodia della figlia.

programme.desc: Dal romanzo di Gioacchino Criaco, un viaggio infernale nel cuore della 'Ndrangheta. In un paesino dell'Aspromonte, l'atto intimidatorio del ventenne Leo nei confronti di un clan rivale riunisce dopo molti anni tre fratelli. Luciano, padre di Leo, vive ancora in Calabria ed e' attaccato alle radici rurali della famiglia. Luigi e Rocco, invece, si sono arricchiti al nord: il primo come narcotrafficante, il secondo entrando nel mondo dell'imprenditoria grazie a un giro di soldi sporchi. La provocazione di Leo li costringera' a un sanguinoso regolamento di conti con il passato.

programme.desc: Federico Zampaglione adatta il suo romanzo in un film con Lorenzo Zurzolo e Giovanni Calcagno. Roma: l'incontro tra musicisti di età diverse cambierà la vita di entrambi.

programme.desc: Isabelle Huppert in un pellicola che entra nel cuore della politica. Prima di concludere il suo mandato, una sindaca vuole realizzare il piano di riqualificazione di una banlieu.

programme.desc: Un padre vedovo cresce la figlia in simbiosi dopo la morte della moglie. Quando cerca di ricostruirsi una vita con una nuova compagna, la reazione della figlia metterà a dura prova il suo amore paterno e la sua capacità di perdonare.

programme.desc: Esordio alla regia del giovane Simone Bozzelli. Yuri ha vent'anni quando incontra Agostino, un animatore girovago con cui inizia un viaggio alla ricerca del senso della liberta'.

programme.title: Paternal Leave
programme.desc: Juli Grabenhenrich e Luca Marinelli in un dramma familiare scritto e diretto da Alissa Jung. Una quindicenne tedesca giunge a Rimini per incontrare finalmente il padre biologico italiano, confrontandosi con l'uomo vulnerabile e tormentato che non l'ha mai voluta conoscere.

programme.title: Marcel!
programme.desc: Opera prima di Jasmine Trinca, con Alba Rohrwacher e Valeria Golino. La figlia di un'artista di strada vuole conquistare l'amore della madre, che sembra essere piu' legata al suo cane.

programme.title: Una figlia
programme.desc: Un padre vedovo cresce la figlia in simbiosi dopo la morte della moglie. Quando cerca di ricostruirsi una vita con una nuova compagna, la reazione della figlia metterà a dura prova il suo amore paterno e la sua capacità di perdonare.

programme.desc: 1 David di Donatello al film di Giuseppe Bonito dal bestseller di Donatella Di Pietrantonio. Una tredicenne torna dalla sua famiglia biologica, passando da una vita agiata alla poverta'.

programme.title: Soldato Jane
programme.desc: Demi Moore e Viggo Mortensen in un film di Ridley Scott. Una donna si sottopone a un addestramento massacrante agli ordini di un sadico istruttore per entrare nei Navy Seals.

programme.desc: Miles Teller nell'esaltante storia del pugile Vinny Pazienza. Reduce da un terribile incidente, il tenace campione non si arrende e torna sul ring per combattere un match leggendario.

programme.title: Ogni maledetta domenica
programme.desc: Oliver Stone dirige Al Pacino e un cast di divi per descrivere il mondo del football americano attraverso la storia di un allenatore in crisi, alla guida di una squadra che non sa piu' vincere. Tony D'Amato e i suoi Miami Sharks perdono una partita dietro l'altra, il quarterback titolare e' fuori per infortunio e la giovane e affascinante proprietaria della squadra e' decisa a far fuori il coach. Ma mandarlo via non e' per nulla facile, la squadra e' con Tony e tra un problema e l'altro riesce a qualificarsi per i playoff. Dentro o fuori, non ci sono alternative.

programme.title: L'ombra del giorno
programme.desc: Giuseppe Piccioni dirige Riccardo Scamarcio e Benedetta Porcaroli. Ascoli Piceno, 1938: un ristoratore filofascista s'innamora della sua nuova cameriera. Ma la ragazza nasconde un segreto.

programme.title: A proposito di Schmidt
programme.desc: 2 Golden Globe al film di Alexander Payne con Jack Nicholson e Kathy Bates. Un vedovo attraversa l'America in un viaggio alla scoperta delle sue emozioni più profonde.

programme.desc: Adriano Sereni, burbero e solitario custode di Villa Guelfi in rovina, vive di routine. L'arrivo di studenti che restaurano la tenuta vicina lo infastidisce. Progetta di cacciarli, ma l'interesse di Matilde trasforma il conflitto in un'alleanza.

programme.desc: Edoardo Leo, Claudia Gerini e un grande cast italiano in un film di Liliana Cavani. Alcuni amici si trovano in una villa sul mare quando scoprono che un asteroide potrebbe colpire la Terra.

programme.desc: Eccentrica commedia Sky Original con Mel Gibson e Charlie Hunnam. Un ex poliziotto lascia la sua casa nel bosco per indagare su un delitto di cui è stato accusato un divo della tv.

programme.desc: Virginie Efira in una commedia amara vincitrice di 6 Cesar. Dopo aver scoperto di essere malata, una donna decide di cercare il figlio che aveva abbandonato da adolescente dopo il parto.

programme.desc: Divertente triangolo amoroso con Geppi Cucciari e il duo comico Luca e Paolo. Un uomo assolda un playboy per indurre in tentazione sua moglie e chiedere finalmente il divorzio.

programme.desc: Paola Cortellesi e Antonio Albanese in un'ironica commedia romantica. Un intellettuale e una cassiera si alleano per interrompere la love story fra i rispettivi figli adolescenti.

programme.desc: Una squadra di comici, capitanati da Christian De Sica ed Enrico Brignano, per una commedia sull'Italia di oggi. I Tucci sono una numerosa famiglia di un paesino laziale. Da sempre poveri, vincono 100 milioni alla lotteria e la loro vita si trasforma. Per non far sapere di essere i fortunati possessori del biglietto, si trasferiscono in un lussuoso hotel milanese dando vita a un'escalation di risate e a una serie di situazioni paradossali. Diretto da Fausto Brizzi, il film e' un remake di "Les Tuche", grande successo in Francia. Gustoso cameo di Al Bano. Nel cast la grande Anna Mazzamauro.

programme.title: On Vodka, Beers and Regrets
programme.desc: It follows the story of Jane Pineda, a washed-up actress and former child star whose career hits rock bottom. Struggling to get movie roles and trying to escape from a big scandal, Jane seeks comfort in alcohol. She then meets Francis who’s a vocalist of a band.

programme.title: Barumbadings
programme.desc: Three gay gangsters mourn the death of their gay guardian, but end up celebrating his bright and colorful life.

programme.title: The Mall The Merrier
programme.desc: After the death of their parents, two estranged sisters must come together to save their family mall from ending up on evil hands.

programme.title: Mananambal
programme.desc: A horror film starring Nora Aunor and Bianca Umali. Set in Siquijor, a Mananambal is a Filipino practitioner of traditional medicine, who is also capable of performing sorcery.

programme.title: Never Not Love You
programme.desc: A young couple with different goals and aspirations face the inevitable when they are both offered jobs abroad.

programme.title: Kidnap for Romance
programme.desc: Ena is a stuntwoman from a family of looters. When her mother needs money to settle her medical bill, she asks her godfather for assistance. Her godfather assigns Elena to abduct Fred Tan, the heir and grandson of one of the richest men in the Philippines, and hold him captive for ransom. When Elena succeeds in capturing Fred and is nearly apprehended by the police, they hide at a villa owned by Fred's family. While Elena is distracted, Fred tries to escape. Elena wrestles with him to prevent him from running away. In the midst of their argument, Fred's grandfather, Henry, pays a visit to the villa and sees them in an improper position. This leads to Henry planning to get them married as soon as possible. Now, Elena and Fred must pretend that their relationship is something more than a botched kidnapping.

programme.title: Won't Last A Day Without You
programme.desc: A female radio DJ who has a popular relationship advice show advises a caller to break up with her boyfriend. Much to the DJ's surprise, that boyfriend shows up at the station, asking for restitution. The DJ tries to help him win his girl back, but the two fall in love in the process.

programme.title: Rigodon
programme.desc: A heartbroken young woman begins a sexual relationship with a struggling artista, not knowing that her new beau is already married. As the truth comes out, obsession and jealousy bring pain into all their lives.

programme.title: Nogomet – Francuska Liga: Psg – Marseille
programme.desc: PSG, vodeći klub, dočekuje Marseille, trećeplasirani, udaljeni 9 bodova. U prvom susretu PSG je slavio 3-2, a Luis Enrique želi potvrditi prednost i dominaciju pred domaćom publikom.

programme.title: Nogomet – Premier League: Chelsea – Manchester United
programme.desc: U prvom susretu sezone Manchester United svladao je Chelsea rezultatom 2:1, a sada ih Bluesi dočekuju na Stamford Bridgeu u utakmici 33. kola Premier League.

programme.title: Nogomet – Talijanska Liga: Lazio – Roma
programme.desc: SS Lazio i Roma igrat će 21. rujna 2025. u četvrtom kolu najjačeg talijanskog nogometnog natjecanja. Koji će tim odnijeti pobjedu u gradskom derbiju na stadionu Olimpico? Susret počinje u 12:30.

programme.title: Shortlist
programme.desc: Magazin koji se bavi prikazivanjem legendarnih i nezaboravnih trenutaka u svijetu sporta, kao i individualnim karijerama sportaša kroz povijest.

programme.title: Shortlist
programme.desc: Magazin koji se bavi prikazivanjem legendarnih i nezaboravnih trenutaka u svijetu sporta, kao i individualnim karijerama sportaša kroz povijest.

programme.title: Nogomet – Ruska Premier Liga: Pari Nn – Cska
programme.desc: Četiri godine Pari Nizhny Novgorod traži recept za pobjedu protiv CSKA Moskve. Novu priliku ima u 29. kolu Ruske Premier lige kad će ih pred svojim navijačima dočekati na Nizhny Novgorod Stadionu.

programme.title: Nogomet – Španjolska Liga: Betis – Sevilla
programme.desc: U 26. kolu španjolske LaLige igraju Real Betis i Sevilla. Na Estadio de la Cartuja domaćini love bodove i poziciju za Ligu prvaka pred svojim navijačima.

programme.title: Nogomet – Europa Liga
programme.desc: Sažetak. Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Europi je službeno pod okriljem UEFA-e od 1971. godine.

programme.title: Nogomet – Premier League: Manchester City – Arsenal
programme.desc: Manchester City i Arsenal odmjerit će snage u 33. kolu Premier League 19. travnja 2026. u 17:30 na Etihad Stadionu.

programme.title: Nogomet – Francuska Liga: Psg – Lens
programme.desc: PSG i Lens odmjerit će snage 14. rujna 2025. u okviru četvrtog kola Ligue 1. Tko će slaviti na Parku Prinčeva? Početak utakmice zakazan je za 17:15 sati.

programme.title: Nogomet – Talijanska Liga: Inter – Milan
programme.desc: Milanski derbi godinama privlači pozornost navijača diljem svijeta, a ni ovaj put nije drukčije — osobito jer su obje momčadi među prve tri na ljestvici.

programme.title: Hokej Na Ledu – Svjetsko Prvenstvo: Finska – Češka
programme.desc: Finska i Češka snage će odmjeriti u četvtrfinalnoj utakmici Svjetskog prvenstva hokeja na ledu koje se održava u Švicarskoj.

programme.title: Košarka – Aba Liga: Liga: Zadar – Split
programme.desc: U play-out fazi ABA lige igraju Zadar i Split. Gosti ulaze u utakmicu s posljednjeg mjesta na tablici, a Zadrani se nadaju pobjedi i kvalifikacijskom play-offu.

programme.title: Nogomet – Njemački Kup: Finale
programme.desc: U Berlinu će se 23. svibnja u finalu Njemačkog kupa sastati rekordni osvajač FC Bayern München i branitelj naslova VfB Stuttgart.

programme.title: Nogomet – Poljska Liga: Katowice – Jagiellonia
programme.desc: Jagiellonia Białystok prijeti Lechu na vrhu tablice, a ako ga želi dostići mora upisati tri boda na gostovanju kod GKS Katowice u 33. kolu Poljske lige.

programme.title: Međunarodna Nogometna Rivalstva
programme.desc: Portugal – Španjolska. Emisija o najvećim međunarodnim nogometnim rivalstvima.

programme.title: Kenny
programme.desc: Dokumentarni film o čuvenom škotskom nogometnom reprezentativcu i napadaču FC Liverpoola, Kennyju Dalglishu.

programme.title: Nogomet – Španjolska Liga: Atletico Madrid – Villareal
programme.desc: Atletico Madrid i Villarreal će se sastati 13. rujna 2025. na stadionu Riyadh Air Metropolitano u četvrtom kolu LaLige. Domaćini priželjkuju prvu ovosezonsku pobjedu. Susret počinje u 21 sat.

programme.title: Nogomet – Premier League: Arsenal – Manchester City
programme.desc: Arsenal i Manchester City odmjerit će snage 21. rujna 2025. na stadionu Emirates u petom kolu Premier lige. Obje momčadi žele upisati nove bodove kojima će napredovati na ljestvici.

programme.title: Nogomet – Liga Prvaka: Bayern – Psg
programme.desc: U prvoj polufinalnoj utakmici Lige prvaka između Bayerna i PSG-a postignuto je devet golova, a na Parku Prinčeva aktualni su prvaci slavili rezultatom 5:4. Spektakl se očekuje i u uzvratu na...

programme.title: Rukomet – Lp (ž): Utakmica Za 3.mjesto
programme.desc: Samo dan nakon dramatičnog polufinala rukometašice Brest Bretagne borit će se za postolje EHF Lige prvakinja protiv Rumunjki iz CSM Bucureștija.

programme.title: Explorers
programme.desc: Dokumentarni film prati sportaše kroz puste pustinje, brze brzace, najviše vrhove i najdublje oceane i predstavlja njihovu beskrajnu želju za novim avanturama.

programme.title: Nogomet – Poljska Liga: Wisla – Gornik
programme.desc: Wisła Płock i Górnik Zabrze podijelili su bodove rezultatom 1:1 u utakmici u studenom.

programme.title: Nogomet – Premier League: Manchester United – Aston Villa
programme.desc: Derbi 30. kola Premier League između Manchester Uniteda i Aston Ville koji se bore za mjesto u Top 4, što donosi izravan plasman u Ligu prvaka na rasporedu je 15. ožujka 2026. u 15:00. Gosti...

programme.title: Prljava Vožnja: Put Do Baja 1000

programme.title: Magazin Lige Prvaka
programme.desc: Pregled vijesti vezanih uz zbivanja na nogometnom travnjaku, za sve ljubitelje nogometa.

programme.title: Nogomet – Europa Liga: Sažetak
programme.desc: Nova sezona Europa lige 2025/26 donosi novi ligaški format i 36 klubova u borbi za trofej!

programme.title: Nogomet – Europa Liga: Genk – Dinamo
programme.desc: U 2. utakmici play-offa UEFA Europa lige KRC Genk ugošćuje Dinamo Zagreb. Ekipa iz Zagreba lovi dva gola zaostatka, a domaćini se nadaju mirnom prolasku, bez iznenađenja na domaćem terenu.

programme.desc: Sažetak. Pogledajte najzanimljivije trenutke utakmica svih faza najvećeg klupskog nogometnog natjecanja u Europi.

programme.title: Nogomet – Liga Prvaka: Finale
programme.desc: Snažan napad PSG-a i Arsenalova stabilna obrana koja je ove sezone primila tek šest golova obilježit će ovo finale.

programme.title: Nogomet – Europa Liga: Freiburg – Braga
programme.desc: Freiburg se upisao u povijest plasmanom u svoje prvo europsko polufinale.

programme.title: Nogomet – Konferencijska Liga: Finale
programme.desc: U finalu Konferencijske lige, najmlađeg europskog natjecanja, sastat će se Crystal Palace i Rayo Vallecano. Borna Sosa nada se svom drugom trofeju s engleskim klubom i plasmanu u Europa ligu.

programme.title: Boks: Wba Svjetsko Prvenstvo: Bailey – Bermudez
programme.desc: Pripremite se za spektakl u ringu: Sara Bailey brani svoj unificirani svjetski naslov u light flyweight kategoriji (108 lbs) protiv izazivačice iz Argentine, Evelyn „La Princesita” Bermudez.

programme.title: Baseball – Mlb: World Series G2
programme.desc: Sezona 2026. počinje utakmicom San Francisco Giantsa i New York Yankees. Velika očekivanja imaju deveterostruki prvaci: mogu li Los Angeles Dodgersi osvojiti i treću titulu za redom?

programme.title: Nogomet – Copa Sudamericana: San Lorenzo – Santos
programme.desc: Santos i San Lorenzo podijelili su bodove rezultatom 1:1. u posljednjem ogledu, a snage će opet odmjeriti u petom kolu Copa Sudamericane u skupini D. Utakmica je na rasporedu 21. svibnja 2026. u...

programme.title: Nfl: Philadelphia – San Francisco
programme.desc: U regularnoj sezoni Eaglesi su imali 11 pobjeda i 6 poraza te osvojili NFC East, dok su 49ersi s 12 pobjeda i 5 poraza završili treći u NFC Westu. Hoće li Eaglesi nadoknaditi poraz iz prosinca 2023.?\r\n.

programme.title: One Žive Za Sport
programme.desc: "One žive za sport" donosi inspirativne priče žena koje posvećuju život sportu.

programme.title: Sport Bez Granica
programme.desc: Uđite u svijet sporta uz našu emisiju i saznajte najnovije vijesti i zanimljivosti!

programme.title: Hokej Na Ledu – Nhl: Montreal – Carolina G4

programme.title: Košarka – Liga Prvaka: Rytas – Tenerife
programme.desc: Rytas Vilnius i La Laguna Tenerife sastat će se u polufinalnoj utakmici košarkaške Lige prvaka.

programme.title: Baseball – Mlb: Cincinatti – Ny Mets
programme.desc: Cincinnati Reds i New York Mets odigrali su prvu seriju međusobnih ogleda ove MLB sezone. Redsi su upisali dvije pobjede, a u posljednjem susretu slavili su Metsi.

programme.title: Nfl: Super Bowl
programme.desc: Super Bowl 60. sezone NFL-a igra se 8. veljače u 23:15. Poluvremenski show donosi Bad Bunny.

programme.title: Nogomet – Copa Libertadores: Sporting Cristal – Palmeiras
programme.desc: Club Sporting Cristal otvorio je grupu F Copa Libertadoresa s dvije pobjede i porazom, dok je Palmeiras upisao dva remija, a pobijedio je samo Sporting Cristal u prvom međusobnom ogledu.

programme.title: Košarka (m) – Kvalifikacije Za Sp: Hrvatska – Cipar
